description: HYRR project-wide configuration — SSoT for values shared across Rust, TypeScript, Python, CI.
data_tarball_doc: Integrity pin for the nuclear-data release tarball (#577). See docs/DATA_INTEGRITY.md. Must match the pinned submodule's catalog data version; core/build.rs fails the build otherwise. Re-pin with: just repin-data
data_signing_pubkey_doc: minisign public key the nuclear-data team signs release tarballs with (#594). Trust root: an offline key, NOT the GitHub release. Published at nucl-parquet docs/security/data-signing-key.pub; rotation is documented there and in docs/maintainers/KEY_ROTATION.md. Deliberately a bare base64 key rather than the two-line .pub file, so nothing in the trust decision depends on parsing an untrusted comment.
